## `src/dispatch.rs`

### struct `Usage`

Reads the bus, applies the allowlist, and queues to `queue.jsonl`; a second timer flushes it. Cheap to hold; all state is on disk or behind the shared stores it was constructed with.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Usage {
    config: Config,
    events: Events,
    agents: Agents,
    projects: Projects,
    version: String,
    shutdown: watch::Sender<bool>,
    done: watch::Sender<bool>,
}
```

## `src/queue.rs`

### struct `QueuedEvent`

One queued item, in the collector's own per-event shape (`collector:src/collect.rs`'s `RECORD_WIRE.itemFields`): a dotted event name, when it happened, a fresh id so a retried POST de-dupes on the collector's side, and this event's own allowed properties — already carrying `version`/`os`/`arch` by the time anything pushes it here.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct QueuedEvent {
    pub id: String,
    pub event: String,
    pub ts_ms: u64,
    pub properties: serde_json::Value,
}
```
